title: Set a Priority Limit for November
teaser: Calling everything important makes real priorities harder to see.
message: Choose no more than three main priorities for this month and mark the rest as supporting work.

title: Clarify Who Owns One Shared File
teaser: Content without a clear owner can quietly become outdated.
message: For one important shared file decide who is responsible for keeping it current.

title: Compare an Estimate With the Actual Result
teaser: Estimation improves when predictions are checked against reality.
message: Take one recent time or cost estimate and place it beside the actual result then note the difference.

title: Recall the Last Time You Used a Subscription
teaser: Recurring charges can continue long after the value disappears.
message: Check when you last genuinely used one paid service and decide whether it still earns its place.

title: Write the Smallest Possible Start for a Task
teaser: Large tasks become easier when the first move is concrete.
message: For one delayed task define a first step that can be done in five minutes and complete only that step.

title: Check Your Backup Recovery Codes
teaser: Two factor recovery options matter most when normal access fails.
message: Confirm that recovery codes for one important account are stored somewhere secure and reachable.

title: Put Rest on the Calendar
teaser: Rest that depends on leftover time is easy to lose.
message: Schedule one short but real rest block during this week.

title: Reduce One Request to a Single Clear Sentence
teaser: Long explanations can hide the actual ask.
message: Before sending one request make sure the central action you want can be stated in one sentence.

title: Define an Early Warning Sign for One Risk
teaser: Small signals can create time to act before a problem grows.
message: For one active piece of work write the earliest sign that would tell you trouble is developing.

title: Write Down the Assumption Behind a Decision
teaser: Many decisions depend on conditions that stay invisible unless named.
message: For one important choice today record the assumption that must remain true for the decision to work.

title: Clean the Downloads Folder
teaser: Temporary files create search and storage clutter when they accumulate.
message: Delete or properly file the items in Downloads that you clearly no longer need.

title: Confirm One Expectation Out Loud
teaser: Unspoken assumptions create avoidable disappointment.
message: For one shared plan explicitly confirm a single important expectation with the other person.

title: Set a Stop Rule Before a Focus Block
teaser: Work can run too long when there is no defined exit point.
message: Before one focused session decide the exact condition that will tell you to pause.

title: Observe the Trigger for One Habit
teaser: Seeing what happens just before a behavior can make change easier.
message: Notice what occurs immediately before one repeated habit today and write it down.

title: List Year End Expenses Early
teaser: December costs are easier to manage when they are visible in advance.
message: Write the major expenses you expect over the next six weeks in one place.

title: Remove One Obsolete Checklist Step
teaser: Controls can collect steps that no longer reduce real risk.
message: Review one checklist you use often and identify whether any step has lost its purpose.

title: Summarize a Topic as if Teaching Someone Else
teaser: Explaining an idea exposes gaps in understanding quickly.
message: Write three short sentences that explain something you learned today to a complete beginner.

title: Consider the Opportunity Cost of One Purchase
teaser: Money used for one purpose cannot be used for another at the same time.
message: For one planned expense write what more valuable goal the same amount could support if you skip the purchase.

title: Review Connected App Access
teaser: Old third party permissions can leave unnecessary access behind.
message: Open the connected apps list for one important account and remove an integration you no longer use.

title: Leave One Open Space Next Week
teaser: A completely packed calendar makes unexpected work harder to absorb.
message: Keep at least one hour next week intentionally unscheduled.

title: Write What Is Out of Scope for a Project
teaser: Clear exclusions protect a project from uncontrolled expansion.
message: For one active project list two things that are intentionally outside the current scope.

title: Rename One Vague Folder
teaser: Clear naming reduces future search time.
message: Change one poorly named folder to a title that describes its contents more precisely.

title: Record the Reproduction Conditions for an Error
teaser: Problems that cannot be reproduced are harder to fix and verify.
message: For one recent issue write the conditions that must be present for the problem to appear.

title: Write the Source Beside an Important Number
teaser: A number is harder to trust when its origin is invisible.
message: Add the source or calculation method beside one important figure you use today.

title: Clarify the Delivery Format for Shared Work
teaser: Finished can mean different things to different people.
message: For one collaboration confirm the expected format and level of detail for the final delivery.

title: Add a Waiting Period to One Purchase
teaser: A short delay can filter impulsive decisions.
message: For one nonessential purchase wait at least a full day before deciding.

title: Find the Slowest Step in One Process
teaser: A single bottleneck can dominate the total time of a workflow.
message: Measure or estimate which step in one routine process creates the most waiting.

title: Ask for the Next Action After Feedback
teaser: Feedback becomes useful when it changes behavior.
message: After one piece of feedback today define in one sentence what you will do differently next.

title: Move Mental Load Onto Paper
teaser: Open loops consume attention when they stay only in memory.
message: Write every unfinished task currently occupying your mind into one trusted list.

title: Close November With One Thing to Stop
teaser: Progress can come from removing low value work rather than adding more.
message: Choose one habit or task that gave you little value in November and decide to leave it behind in December.
